tasks.title: HANGS Construction Services · FY2026 Year-End Audit
tasks.description: Audit HANGS Construction Services LLC’s FY2026 books from 16 Excel and PDF files: the client’s trial balance, general ledger and statements, the vendors’ invoices, the payables and the payments after the year end, the board’s minutes, and the reports and letter the bank sent the audit team directly. Recompute the trial balance from every ledger line, propose materiality, vouch a seeded sample, search for unrecorded bills, test every journal, agree the dividends to the board, tie cash to the bank, compare the year with last year and set every area’s findings against materiality. Produce formula-linked workpapers with tickmarks and a draft findings memo. The CPA reviews, decides every open item and concludes; the machine gives no opinion.
